wikipedia.title: Zinza people
wikipedia.intro: The Zinza (Swahili: Wazinza) are a Bantu ethnolinguistic group from the southwestern Islands on Lake Victoria, Tanzania. The Zinza people also lived on the shores of Geita Region's Chato District and Geita District  and Mwanza Region. In 1987, the Zinza population was estimated to be 138,000 [1].
wikipedia.full_text:
The Zinza (Swahili: Wazinza) are a Bantu ethnolinguistic group from the southwestern Islands on Lake Victoria, Tanzania. The Zinza people also lived on the shores of Geita Region's Chato District and Geita District  and Mwanza Region. In 1987, the Zinza population was estimated to be 138,000 [1].
